name: Moxisylyte

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1993 — for liver harm

summary: Moxisylyte was pulled from the market in France, beginning in 1993, due to liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a low score of 40 for liver concerns and a low score of 32 for heart concerns [M].
